name: @awardgrid/ios
description: The awardgrid client shell (docs/PIVOT.md §6 Phase 2): a Capacitor app that runs on the user's own seats.aero account (the App Store build through seats.aero's own sign-in, with the stateless token service in sites/auth; development builds with a pasted key), with no server of ours in the data path.

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/check-fixture-free-bundle.mjs && node scripts/acknowledgements.mjs --check
scripts.build:store: VITE_AG_STORE=1 VITE_AG_CONNECT=oauth vite build && node scripts/check-fixture-free-bundle.mjs && node scripts/check-store-bundle.mjs && node scripts/acknowledgements.mjs --check
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
